messages:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] ingress.gateway.prod elevated 504s/timeouts detected (5m p95 1.2% vs baseline 0.02%). Paging #oncall-ingress -> @kira

kira: oncall here, joining. Any customer-facing impact? :eyes:

morgan: support: seeing ~30 customer 504 reports in last 10m, spike from webhook ingestion. acme-corp has ~120 failed requests in last 15m.

kira: thanks. Lee, can you pull traces + correlation ids? any queue depth or headroom spikes?

lee: grabbing traces now. quick hypothesis: upstream rt-proxy tails causing gateway timeouts. sample corr ids: 9f2c1b3a, 9f2c1b3c. attaching kvlog snippet.

lee: ```
2026-05-10T14:11:03Z corr=9f2c1b3a req_id=abc123 upstream=rt-proxy-2 status=504 backend_latency=12.4s
2026-05-10T14:11:04Z corr=9f2c1b3b req_id=abc124 upstream=rt-proxy-1 status=200 backend_latency=0.45s
2026-05-10T14:11:06Z corr=9f2c1b3c req_id=abc126 upstream=rt-proxy-2 status=504 backend_latency=10.8s
```

jamie: I see retry amplification in traces — clients retry with short backoffs and our gateway is queuing requests. Are gateway retries enabled for 504?

kira: gateway retries config: retries on 502/503 only; but we rolled in an ingress queueing change last week that increases inflight allowed. That might reduce headroom.

kira: short mitigation plan: disable any extra retry shim for 5xx at gateway, add 1s jitter to client SDK backoff, and scale ingress headroom if needed. @deploy-bot can you push a 1min patch to disable gw retry for 504?

deploy-bot: Starting rollout: patch disable-gw-retry-504 -> hosts 0/3 completed.

morgan: customer impact: acme-corp webhook consumers are timing out; support notified, creating incident ticket and bridge for notifications.

deploy-bot: Rollout progress: 1/3 hosts -> 2/3 hosts -> ETA ~40s.

lee: uploaded trace bundle and kvlogs: https://internal.redwood/trace/9f2c1b3a-bundle and /var/dropbox/ingress/1719809999.zip (contains sample traces + pod logs with corr ids).

kira: monitoring p95 and error-rate. If error-rate <0.1% sustained for 5m we can mark mitigation successful.

jamie: hypothesis tracker (in-thread):
- H1: rt-proxy slow tail causes gateway timeouts.
- H2: client retry amplification increases load on slow tails.
- H3: ingress queueing change reduced capacity headroom.
Next actions: correlate corr ids to upstream pod cpu, network drops, and GC pauses; collect client-side retry patterns. Lee to collect pod metrics and post.

lee: collecting pod metrics now (cpu, net drops, socket queues). I see rt-proxy-2 had a CPU spike and increased accept queue. posting metrics in 3m.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete on hosts 3/3. Changes live.

kira: mitigation in place; p95 dropped to 0.07%, error-rate back to baseline. Handing off to #incidents-rca for timeline and full RCA. tagging @eng-sre @eng-runtime.

morgan: will update affected customers with mitigation note and ETA for RCA. opening customer postmortem draft.

lee: posted pod-level dumps and additional kvlog at /var/dropbox/ingress/1719809999-additional.zip. Will correlate with trace bundle and report back.

kira: thanks all — closing pager but keeping channel open for RCA tracking.
